main_text.l: אֲשַׁחְקֶם contundam eos, fut. Kal, 1. s. aff. R. שָׁחַק.
אֲשַׁחַרְךָ requiram te mane, fut. Piel, 1. s. aff. R. שָׁחַר.
אֲשַׁחִיתֵם perdam eos, fut. Hiph. 1. sing. aff. Rad. שָׁחַת.
אֵשׁ sacrificia ignita, ׳ _ mea, מֵאֵשׁ ab ignitis meis, pl. m. præf. aff. No. אִשָּׁה, Rad. אֵשׁ.
אָשִׁיב, ה reducam, נוּ reducam eum, &c. 1. sing. fut. Hiph. parag. & aff. R. שׁוּב.
אַשִּׂיג assequar, ם eos, נוּ eum, &c. 1. sing. fut. Hiph. aff. R. נָשַׂג. [?]
אִשָּׁה fundamentum, אֲשׁוּתֶיהָ fundamenta ejus, No. f. & pl. fem. aff. Rad. אָשָׁה.
אֲשִׂיחָה eloqui faciam, 1. s. fut. hiph. Rad. שׂוּחַ. [?]
אֲשִׂים, ה ponam, ךָ te, ם eos, נוּ eum, &c. 1. sing. fut. Hiph. parag. & aff. Rad. שׂוּם.
אֶשְׁעֶה respiciam, fut. Kal 1. s. Rad. שָׁעָה.
אֲשִׁיר, ה canam, 1. s. fut. Hiph. parag. Rad. שִׁיר.
אֶשְׁאֵשׁ gaudebo, 1. s. fut. Hiph. R. שׁשׁ. [?]
אֲשִׁשׁ fundamentum, ים fundamenta, & אֲשִׁישָׁה lagena, No. s. & pl. m. & No. f. fem. R. אָשַׁשׁ. [?]
אִשִּׁית ponam, ךָ ה te, הוּ eum, &c. 1. sing. fut. Hiph. aff. Rad. שׁוּת. [?]
אֲשְׁכִּים mane surgam, fut. Hiph. 1. s. Rad. שָׁכַם. [?]
אֶשְׁכֹּל botrus, אֶשְׁכְּלוֹת, אֶשְׁכְּלוֹת botri, No. s. m. & pl. fem. R. שָׁכַל orbare.
אֶשְׁכָּר donum, אֶשְׁכָּרְךָ munus tuum, No. s. m. aff. Rad. שָׁכַר inebriare.
אֲשֵׁם, אָשֵׁם desolabo, 1. sing. fut. Kal, Rad. שָׁמַם.

page.notes: Vowel points and some Hebrew forms in the entries are hard to read at this scan resolution and are transcribed with [?] where doubtful. The line-initial Hebrew headwords are rendered as best read; check against the original. The right-hand column's first line continues the entry for "ponam" from the left column.
